hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;)[[:space:]]*(npm run deploy|npx dt-app deploy|dt-app deploy)([[:space:]]|$)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"RELEASE STEP \u2014 update the README before this deploy. Verify README.md reflects everything shipped since the last release: new or changed tabs, panels, capabilities, cross-cutting features, npm scripts, OAuth scopes, the test-count line, and the version number. If anything new shipped without a README change, update README.md now (then commit it), then continue the deploy. If the README is already current, proceed."}}'; fi
